root: ^The soldier glares at you as you approach. It's clear he doesn't seem to trust you one bit. "What business do you have here, foreigner?"

choices: ^What can you tell me about this place?
identity: ^The man maintains his glare on you as he pauses before speaking, assessing you.

b: ^"Who I am is none of your business, you damned lout. Make yourself sparse, soon."

identity: ^You pause, half expecting a continued response, but it never comes.
converse: ^The man sighs, seemingly offended by your continued existence and presence.

b: ^"I protect this village. The lives of these people far outweighs the value of my own."
^"I'm just a simple guard, bother someone else. "

ally: ^The man puffs out his chest, attempting to appear far larger and stronger than he is as he looks down at you.

b: ^"Honestly? I'm just a bit caught up in the war mentality. I've never seen you around so I'm just on guard."
^"You wouldn't understand. You foreigners are dangerous threats to this village"
^"Damn you, the war will be over soon and you'll regret antagonizing this village"
^"The war is none of your business, civilian"
^"This is the mighty home of our wonderful people. Countless souls have flourished here through the graces of the gods."
^"What is there to say? There's nothing here for you."

glare: ^You jaunt up to the man, matching his glare with one of your own. The both of you hold your glares as long as possible, lamenting the other's existence.
protected: ^Your agreement with his values catches the man slightly off guard. He just nods for a moment "Indeed, perhaps you're not all bad."
foreign: ^The soldier frowns deeply in response to your claim. "No this is not a joke! I knew there was something wrong with you, damned foreigner"
calm: ^You wait for him to cool down before confronting him about his anger. He sighs and apologizes "I was a bit out of line, just watch yourself, alright?"
applaud: ^You applaud the man's apparent devotion to his village. He gives you a light bow and a smile "You're a good guy for a foreigner"
